description: This file provides mock implementations and wrapper functions for NetworkManager's libnm API, facilitating testing and mocking of network operations in a C++ environment. It includes external function declarations, wrapper methods for various network management functions, and a singleton pattern for managing the implementation.

classes.name: LibnmWraps
classes.description: Singleton class providing mockable wrappers around NetworkManager's libnm API functions, enabling unit testing and isolation of network operations.
